title: v3-tiling-advisor-and-tenant-safe-rollout-plan
creator: Priya Nambiar
description:
Problem: Recent FlashAttention v3 integrations improved throughput on many shapes but produced intermittent decode latency regressions for some multi-tenant workloads and long-context traces. Root cause hypotheses include suboptimal microtile choice for certain head counts / sequence lengths, workspace allocation fragmentation across tenants, and prober-induced warmup jitter.

Goal: Build a Tiling Advisor that recommends per-model and per-tenant tile/microtile parameters, plus a tenant-safe rollout plan for v3 kernels that minimizes regression blast radius. Deliverables: 1) deterministic microbenchmark harness that reproduces the regression shape on CI; 2) Tiling Advisor service (offline model + lightweight runtime hints) that produces recommended kernel parameters and confidence score; 3) Canary/tenant-gated rollout automation and fallback policy to v2 or quantized kernels; 4) dashboards and an automated rollback trigger when service-level percentiles regress beyond threshold.

Acceptance criteria: 
- Tiling Advisor recommendations reduce median per-token latency for targeted shapes by >=5% vs current v2 baseline for at least 3 internal models, without increasing 99th percentile by >2% for non-targeted tenants.
- CI harness reproduces reported regression within 95th percentile of on-prod traces and is runnable in perf-lab.
- Canary runbook and automation successfully promote v3 kernels to 20% tenant traffic, monitor latency / error deltas, and automatically revert to v2 if 95th percentile latency increases >7% or error-rate increases >3x baseline.

Design notes and constraints:
- The Advisor should be conservative: prefer choices that trade small throughput loss for stability. It must emit: tile_size, microtile, workspace_budget_hint, and confidence_tag (low/med/high).
- Avoid per-request heavy computation: runtime will consult cached per-model recommendations keyed by model-id + context-length bucket.
- Multi-tenant safety: maintain per-tenant override blacklist and allow per-tenant opt-out; rollout controller uses tenant affinity to limit blast radius.
- Reproducible harness must ingest anonymized token-length histograms and head counts; use captured KV-cache warmup traces from prod (sanitized) via perf-trace pipeline.

Implementation plan (milestones):
1) Week 1 (Feb 14-21): Prototype microbenchmark harness and gather representative traces for failing tenants. Create initial tile-parameter search grid and run offline sweep.
2) Week 2 (Feb 22-Mar 1): Build Advisor service prototype (offline scoring) + simple policy to persist recommendations to service config. Implement per-tenant blacklist and metadata schema.
3) Week 3 (Mar 2-8): Integrate Advisor lookup into runtime hotpath (read-only, cached). Add canary controller: route 5% -> 20% by tenant affinity. Add telemetry: per-tenant latency deltas, workspace OOMs, kernel selection counts.
4) Week 4 (Mar 9-20): Run canary on staging then production canary (selected internal tenants). Evaluate, iterate, and prepare rollback automation.

Telemetry and Monitoring:
- New metrics: advisor.recommendation_confidence, kernel.selection.counts.{v2,v3,quant}, tenant.latency.delta.p50/p95/p99, tenant.kernel.workspace-ooms, tile.size.distribution.
- Dashboards: per-model tiling heatmap, tenant impact map, canary progress timeline.
- Alerting: pager when production canary triggers rollback criteria or workspace OOM rate spikes 5x baseline.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Advisor recommendations overfit to sweep traces and degrade other tenants. Mitigation: conservative confidence thresholds; require cross-tenant A/B evaluation before widescale promotion.
- Risk: Runtime integration adds overhead. Mitigation: caching + read-only path; measure CPU impact in perf-lab.
- Risk: Workspace fragmentation causes OOMs under mixed workloads. Mitigation: workspace_budget_hint and tenant-specific caps; fallback to v2 on OOM.

Artifacts: 
- Perf harness prototype: github.com/redwood/perf/tiling-advisor-probe (PR pending)
- Design doc: confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Tiling+Advisor+Design
- Initial offline sweep results: s3://redwood-perf/tiling-sweeps/2025-02-18/results.csv

Next steps: schedule sync with runtime owners, perf lab reservation for 48h sweep, identify two internal tenants for staged canary (Billing and Search teams).
